targets.rawSql: SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(charge_energy_added)::numeric, 1), 0) FROM charging_sessions WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND $__timeFilter(start_time)
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(SUM(cost)::numeric, 2), 0) FROM charging_sessions WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND $__timeFilter(start_time)
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(charge_energy_added)::numeric, 1), 0) FROM charging_sessions WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND $__timeFilter(start_time)
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(cost)::numeric, 2), 0) FROM charging_sessions WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND cost > 0 AND $__timeFilter(start_time)
SELECT COALESCE(ROUND(AVG(max_charger_power)::numeric), 0) FROM charging_sessions WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND $__timeFilter(start_time)
SELECT ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE charger_type = 'DC') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0)::numeric, 1) FROM charging_sessions WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND $__timeFilter(start_time)

SELECT date_trunc('month', start_time) AS time, SUM(cost) FILTER (WHERE charger_type IS NULL OR charger_type != 'DC') AS "AC Cost" FROM charging_sessions WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND cost > 0 AND $__timeFilter(start_time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('month', start_time) AS time, SUM(cost) FILTER (WHERE charger_type = 'DC') AS "DC Cost" FROM charging_sessions WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND cost > 0 AND $__timeFilter(start_time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('month', start_time) AS time, SUM(charge_energy_added) FILTER (WHERE charger_type IS NULL OR charger_type != 'DC') AS "AC Energy" FROM charging_sessions WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND $__timeFilter(start_time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT date_trunc('month', start_time) AS time, SUM(charge_energy_added) FILTER (WHERE charger_type = 'DC') AS "DC Energy" FROM charging_sessions WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND $__timeFilter(start_time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

SELECT TO_CHAR(start_time, 'Dy') AS "Day", COUNT(*) AS "Sessions", ROUND(SUM(charge_energy_added)::numeric, 1) AS "kWh" FROM charging_sessions WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND $__timeFilter(start_time) GROUP BY EXTRACT(DOW FROM start_time), TO_CHAR(start_time, 'Dy') ORDER BY EXTRACT(DOW FROM start_time)

SELECT LPAD(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM start_time)::text, 2, '0') || ':00' AS "Hour", COUNT(*) AS "Sessions" FROM charging_sessions WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND $__timeFilter(start_time) GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM start_time), 1 ORDER BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM start_time)

SELECT COALESCE(a.display_name, a.city, 'Unknown') AS "Location", ROUND(SUM(cs.charge_energy_added)::numeric, 1) AS "kWh", COUNT(*) AS "Sessions" FROM charging_sessions cs LEFT JOIN addresses a ON cs.address_id = a.id WHERE cs.vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND $__timeFilter(cs.start_time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT start_time AS time, ROUND((cost / NULLIF(charge_energy_added, 0))::numeric, 3) AS "$/kWh" FROM charging_sessions WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND cost > 0 AND charge_energy_added > 0 AND $__timeFilter(start_time) ORDER BY start_time
SELECT start_time AS time, max_charger_power AS "Max Power" FROM charging_sessions WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND $__timeFilter(start_time) ORDER BY start_time
SELECT start_time AS time, charge_energy_added AS "kWh Added" FROM charging_sessions WHERE vehicle_id = $vehicle_id AND $__timeFilter(start_time) ORDER BY start_time
